runs.sql: SELECT i.freq,count(*) FROM signal_message m JOIN sigint_inbox_item i ON i.id=m.id WHERE m.id BETWEEN 3506000 AND 3506200 AND i.id BETWEEN 3506000 AND 3506200 AND NOT m.deleted AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sigint_inbox_item_unit l JOIN sigint_unit u ON u.id=l.unit_id WHERE l.item_id=i.id AND l.unit_id=33 AND NOT u.deleted AND l.item_id BETWEEN 3506000 AND 3506200) GROUP BY i.freq ORDER BY i.freq
